places.name: Abra Creek Crossing
places.description: Cross Dubai Creek between Bur Dubai and the Deira souks on a traditional wooden abra holding about 20 people. AED 1 per crossing (AED 2 air-conditioned), boats every few minutes from 6am; a private abra along the creek is about AED 120 per hour.

places.name: DEWA Sustainability and Innovation Centre
places.area: Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum Solar Park
places.description: Interactive centre at the world's largest single-site solar park: exhibits on clean energy, wind and desalination, drone and hologram shows, a virtual tour of the solar park and an autonomous bus ride. Tickets on the centre's website or app.
